title: Green Electrolyzer
summary: Power an electrolyzer with renewable electricity and split water into hydrogen and oxygen.
coachPrompt: Connect solar and wind power, then start electrolysis. Watch H₂ form at the negative electrode and O₂ at the positive electrode.
teachingPoints: Electrolysis uses electricity to split water into hydrogen and oxygen.
Green hydrogen is made with renewable electricity and water.
Colour names (grey, blue, green) describe how hydrogen was produced — not the colour of the gas.
